claims.statement: For the single total family f_n(x)=OR(x_1,...,x_n) for every integer n>=0, with f_0(empty)=0, the language L={x:f_|x|(x)=1} is in NP, and unconditionally liminf as n tends to infinity of C_B2(f_n)/n >= 1, in the full B2 model of rules.md, with n=|x| the actual input length and the bound covering every sufficiently large integer length.
